description: This Java source file defines the ConceptClassEditor class, which extends OpenmrsPropertyEditor to serialize and deserialize ConceptClass objects using IDs and UUIDs, within the OpenMRS health information system framework.

classes.name: ConceptClassEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting between ConceptClass objects and their string representations (by ID or UUID).

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptClass object given its integer ID, via the ConceptService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptClass object given its UUID string, via the ConceptService.
